steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ event without creating or searching for another event.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the test configuration.
Apply the required post-expiry surrogate-bid configuration.
Enable buyer editing of bidding fields as required.
Open the RFQ Responses tab where Download Report is available.
Confirm that the Download Reports window opened.
Set the revised-bids option off for the first report download.
Verify the Include Revised Bids control is off.
Download the report without revised bids.
Verify that the Excel report downloads successfully with revised bids excluded.
Reopen the Download Reports window for the enabled-option case.
Confirm the report dialog is available again.
Enable inclusion of revised bids for Vendor A.
Verify that Include Revised Bids is on.
Download the report with revised bids included.
Verify that the enabled-option Excel report downloads and contains Vendor A's report data.
